findings.summary: Round-4's minor was fixed by deleting the number from SPEC.md:434, but the SAME number sits in this commit's own M5.32 State cell against the SAME 19-commit span -- 'the two agreed and were both wrong from 66f4020 to d043479, thirteen commits back', and git rev-list --count 66f4020..d043479 is 19
findings.detail: The round-5 disposition of my round-4 minor is the RIGHT one and I do not ask for it back: SPEC.md:434 now reads 'they agreed and were both wrong, which is why nothing caught it', which is the causal claim, is true, and carries no number. A SPEC Tasks row is the wrong home for a measured commit span -- this repository's convention puts measurements in the backlog State cell -- so deleting rather than correcting to 19 does not under-inform: the quantified windows are both in backlog.md, at :71 (contradiction, d043479..HEAD) and :41 (agreement, 66f4020..d043479). BUT the defect I described at round 4 still stands at backlog.md:41, one file over, in the cell whose job is to record the measurement. MEASURED out of tree: git rev-list --count 66f4020..d043479 = 19, and git rev-list --count d043479..HEAD = 13. The natural reading of 'from 66f4020 to d043479, thirteen commits back' is the length of the span just named, and that is 19, not 13. The only reading under which 'thirteen' is true is 'd043479 is thirteen commits back from HEAD' -- and that one goes stale the instant this commit lands, because d043479 becomes FOURTEEN back. Contrast backlog.md:71, which states its window exactly and stably: 'the SPEC contradicted itself from d043479 to here -- two SPEC.md-touching commits, thirteen in absolute terms' (verified: 13 commits, of which d354af9 and d5b5f21 touch SPEC.md). UNCHANGED SINCE ROUND 4 -- the only backlog edit between 06e164a28f19 and bd41f487703f is the M0.109 row -- so this is a site I missed at round 4 rather than one this round introduced. NOT WORTH A ROUND 6: review.md rule 11, and this task is already exhibiting exactly that loop (a round-4 minor bought a round-5 prose edit whose surface is this finding). Record it in the commit body or leave it.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader auditing how long this class of error survived opens the M5.32 done cell -- the cell written to be the record -- reads 'from 66f4020 to d043479, thirteen commits back', and takes 13 as the agreement window. They then run git rev-list --count 66f4020..d043479, get 19, and cannot tell whether the cell means the span (wrong by 6) or d043479's distance from a HEAD that has since moved (stale by one the moment M5.32 lands). Either way the number they were given to check the claim with does not check out, in the one cell whose stated purpose is that it was MEASURED.
